g.text: Anomalous behavior — causality via out-of-band channel
Reality: A physically happened before B.
Lamport timestamps: TB = 10 < TA = 50 → system orders B before A. Anomaly.
Cause: causality (A → B) flowed outside the system, so no message captured it.
1. User passes TA along on the phone; B is stamped later than TA.
2. Use physical clocks satisfying Strong Clock Condition: ε ≤ μ(1 − κ).
